mismatches.name: bash/pitfall-read-arith-injection.sh
mismatches.desc: arithmetic on read input evaluates array subscripts (code injection demo)
mismatches.tags: cash-divergence (spec section 4 row 27: arithmetic never runs $(...) from a variable value)
mismatches.script:
# source: https://mywiki.wooledge.org/BashPitfalls#read_num.3B_echo_.24.28.28num.2B1.29.29
# desc: arithmetic on read input evaluates array subscripts (code injection demo)
# tags: cash-divergence (spec section 4 row 27: arithmetic never runs $(...) from a variable value)
echo 'a[$(echo injection >&2)]' | { read num; echo $((num+1)); } 2>&1

cash.stderr: [31merror:[39m arithmetic evaluation error: failed to parse expression: $(echo injection >&2)

mismatches.name: sed/gnu-doubled-words.sh
mismatches.desc: find doubled words on one line and across lines with \b \w \s
mismatches.script:
# source: https://www.gnu.org/software/sed/manual/html_node/Text-search-across-multiple-lines.html
# desc: find doubled words on one line and across lines with \b \w \s
# tags: gnu-ext (\b, \w, \s)
printf 'It was the best of times,\nit was the worst of times,\nit was the the age of wisdom,\n' > dup1.txt
sed -En '/\b(\w+)\s+\1\b/{=;p}' dup1.txt
printf 'It was the best of times, it was the\nworst of times, it was the\nthe age of wisdom,\nit was the age of foolishness,\n' > dup2.txt
sed -En '{N; /\b(\w+)\s+\1\b/{=;p} ; D}' dup2.txt

bash.stdout:
3
it was the the age of wisdom,
3
worst of times, it was the
the age of wisdom,

mismatches.name: sed/gnu-join-backslash.sh
mismatches.desc: join backslash-continued lines (manual notes it requires GNU sed)
mismatches.tags: gnu-ext (label and branch terminated without newline)
mismatches.script:
# source: https://www.gnu.org/software/sed/manual/html_node/Joining-lines.html
# desc: join backslash-continued lines (manual notes it requires GNU sed)
# tags: gnu-ext (label and branch terminated without newline)
printf 'this \\\nis \\\na \\\nlong \\\nline\nand another \\\nline\n' | sed -e ':x /\\$/ { N; s/\\\n//g ; bx }'

bash.stdout:
this is a long line
and another line

cash.stderr: cash.exe: <script argument 1>:1:4: error: extra characters at the end of the : command

mismatches.name: sed/pement-dos2unix-dot.sh
mismatches.desc: convert DOS newlines (CR/LF) to Unix format, assumes all lines end with CR/LF
mismatches.tags: cash-divergence (D49: s/.$// names no CR, so it removes the last visible character)
mismatches.script:
# source: https://www.pement.org/sed/sed1line.txt (TEXT CONVERSION)
# desc: convert DOS newlines (CR/LF) to Unix format, assumes all lines end with CR/LF
# tags: cash-divergence (D49: s/.$// names no CR, so it removes the last visible character)
printf 'one\r\ntwo\r\n' | sed 's/.$//' | tr '\r' R
